Categorical arrays

Source: R/io-values-categorical.R
io-categorical.Rd

Reads and writes the Element categorical (version 0.2.0), a group with the boolean attribute ordered and the members codes and categories.

Usage

write_factor(store, key, value, dataset_kwargs, path)

Arguments

store

An open rhdf5 file or group handle.

key

Name of the Element within store, "/" writes into the root.

value

The R value to write.

dataset_kwargs

A list of dataset creation options.

path

Path of the Element within store.

Details

A factor is written as an unordered and an ordered factor as an ordered categorical. R levels are always strings, so non-string categories (Python's integer, float and boolean categories) are read as the string form of the category and the original categories are kept in the anndata_categories attribute of the factor. They are written back with their own dtype as long as the levels still match them, and as strings otherwise (so subsetting a factor with [ writes string categories).

Codes use the smallest signed integer dtype pandas picks for the number of categories, whatever dtype the file had. NA is the code -1 and unused levels are kept.
